description: Land Acquisition - Vadduvakallu and Vellammullivaikkal, Maritimepattu D/S Division, Mullaittivu District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a formal declaration for acquiring specific parcels of land (described by lot numbers, boundaries, and exact measurements) for public purpose. The content focuses entirely on land matters - describing the location, extent, and boundaries of the properties to be acquired. While it mentions a government minister, this is only in the context of making the land acquisition declaration, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core subject matter is land acquisition, making it a clear Land Gazette.
